fusions.name: Foul Warning
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 12 damage and poisons the target for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tail Flick
fusions.desc: Looses 3 sprays at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage and having a 25% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Standoff
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Lingering Notice
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
